# `∞` — Infinity

`∞` and `¯∞` are approximate real infinities.

```apl
∞+3                ⍝ ∞
3÷∞                ⍝ 0
⌊/⍬                ⍝ ∞
⌈/⍬                ⍝ ¯∞
```

`¯∞` < every finite real < `∞`. Each infinity equals itself. Empty min/max identities are infinite even for exact arrays. As IEEE 754 defines, an undefined result with an infinity is NaN:

```apl
∞-∞                ⍝ $n
0×∞                ⍝ $n
```

## Errors

- `DOMAIN`: an infinite index or count
